logtime.title: Logtime
logtime.subtitle: Draft your hours here, push them to each PMS over MCP — {h}h a day
logtime.month.label: {month} {year}
logtime.day.empty: Nothing logged yet — add a line below.
logtime.form.note: What did you do? — one sentence, exactly as it lands on the PMS
logtime.form.noteSeedEmpty: Type a few words first, then Refine with AI.
logtime.form.noteRefineFailed: AI could not refine it — try again or write it yourself.
logtime.bar.cleanSub: Every line of this day is on the PMS
logtime.bar.blocked: {n} lines have no PMS project — fix it under Setup
logtime.legend.locked: Locked — the PMS finalized it, cannot edit
logtime.push.title: Confirm push to PMS
logtime.push.warn: This writes to the real PMS. Nothing is sent until you tick the box and press the button.
logtime.push.blocked: {n} lines are skipped — their project is not linked to the PMS, or the PMS source cannot log time.
logtime.push.confirm: I reviewed the {n} lines ({h}h) above and agree to write them to the PMS.
logtime.push.hintDone: The PMS has the lines. To change them, edit on the PMS directly.
logtime.report.title: Daily report
logtime.report.copyFailed: Could not copy — the clipboard is blocked
logtime.report.hint: Read-only. To write to the PMS use the Push button.
logtime.report.excluded: {n} lines are not in the JSON sent to the PMS — the brief and table formats still list them all.
logtime.suggest.title: What you did today
logtime.suggest.sessionGone: Session not found — it may have been deleted.
logtime.suggest.untracked: {n} items in projects not linked to a PMS — link them in Setup to log
logtime.suggest.skipped: {n} items belong to no project and cannot be logged
logtime.suggest.failed: Could not read what you did today — the numbers below may be short.
logtime.week.label: Week {n} · {from} – {to}
logtime.week.meta: {total}/{budget} hours · {worked} working days · {open} not yet settled
logtime.week.legend.empty: Empty cell = no work on that project that day
logtime.ai.title: Compose logtime with AI
logtime.ai.sub: Ephemeral session, agent logtime-writer — does not clutter your session list
logtime.ai.busy: Composing from what was measured today…
logtime.ai.noEngine: No engine — open the desktop app to use Compose with AI.
logtime.ai.failed: The model did not return a usable draft. Try again or compose manually.
logtime.ai.contextTitle: AWOG injected this context into the session
logtime.ai.none: The model produced no valid lines. Compose manually on the Day tab.
logtime.ai.hint: Accepting still leaves them as drafts — you must Push and confirm to send to the PMS.
logtime.ai.acceptedNone: Nothing added — the day may be full or the lines duplicate.
logtime.task.title: Attach a task
logtime.task.sub: From worklog_list_tasks of the linked project
logtime.task.none: No tasks registered for this project.
logtime.task.search: Search tasks by id or name…
logtime.task.hint: Only issues auto-link; PR links belong in the note.
logtime.setup.sourcesHint: only the sources you add below are used to push hours
logtime.setup.noSources: No MCP source is enabled yet — add one under Sources.
logtime.setup.noMoreSources: Every enabled MCP source is already added.
logtime.setup.noSourcePicked: No PMS source picked yet — add one below.
logtime.setup.errSourceGone: This source is gone from AWOG — remove it and add it again.
logtime.setup.errNotMcp: This source is not MCP, so Logtime cannot call it.
logtime.setup.errDisabled: This source is disabled — turn it back on under Sources.
logtime.setup.pmsLoadFailed: Could not load projects from the PMS: {error}
logtime.setup.missingTools: Missing: {tools}. Logtime keeps this source read-only.
logtime.setup.noLinks: No project tracked yet — add one below.
logtime.setup.allLinked: Every AWOG project is already tracked.
logtime.setup.noProjects: No project registered in AWOG yet.
logtime.setup.dailyHint: AWOG blocks anything over this and warns when the day is short. Changing it updates the whole screen.
logtime.setup.roundHint: Measured durations are rounded UP to this step. The ± buttons follow it too.
logtime.setup.remind: Remind me when the day is short
logtime.toast.full: This day already has {h}h — remove a line before adding another.
logtime.toast.duplicate: That line already exists today — edit the old one instead.
logtime.toast.invalid: Pick a project and write what you did.
logtime.toast.cut: Trimmed from {from}h to {to}h to fit the day.
logtime.toast.editFailed: Could not edit this line — it is already on the PMS or locked.
logtime.toast.editPostedDrift: This line is already on the PMS — editing here only changes the AWOG copy; the PMS keeps the old value.
logtime.toast.copyNone: Nothing copied — the day is full or every line is already there.
logtime.toast.copyDetail: {dup} already there · {full} did not fit · {cut} trimmed
logtime.toast.pushFailed: {n} lines failed — they are still drafts
logtime.toast.noLink: Link this project to a PMS project first (Setup).
logtime.toast.tasksFailed: Could not load the task list from the PMS.
logtime.confirm.removePosted.title: Remove a line already on the PMS?
logtime.confirm.removePosted.body: This only removes it from AWOG. The worklog stays on the PMS until you delete it there.
